text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when fixes are simple and cheap. This saves time and prevents small mistakes from becoming serious problems later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's solutions and discuss different approaches. In addition, regular reviews improve overall team quality by keeping the code clean, consistent, and easy to maintain. For these reasons, every development team should treat code reviews as a normal and valuable step in their daily work.
